description: I.P. Menika v. W.M. Siriwardena and Others I.P. Menika v. W.M. Siriwardena and Others View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: I.P. Menika v. W.M. Siriwardena and Others I.P. Menika v. W.M. Siriwardena and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant sought to challenge the propriety of the judgement of the District Court given in favour of the Respondents, who sought a declaration of title and ejectment of the Appellant from a paddy field. The Appellant admitted ownership but claimed rights as an ‘ande’ cultivator, raising jurisdiction and prescription defences. Evidence, including agricultural registers and payment receipts, showed the Appellant was paid wages rather than recognised as a cultivator. Held - Appeal dismissed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
